data.cultural_impact: The name Rodrigo has been popular throughout history, especially in the Iberian peninsula, where it was used among the royalty and nobility of Spain and Portugal. Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar, better known as El Cid, is one of the most famous bearers of the name. He was a Castilian nobleman who lived in the 11th and early 12th centuries and is renowned for his military prowess. The name Rodrigo continues to be used in the Spanish-speaking world and is associated with strength, leadership, and martial prowess.
